## Why This Is Asked
Tests the ability to design observability systems with robust tenant isolation in CNF platforms, focusing on end-to-end tracing, data segmentation, and practical implementation.

## Key Concepts
- Distributed tracing fundamentals and W3C Trace Context
- Tenant-scoped attributes and resource naming conventions
- Telemetry routing strategies (tenant-based exporters, dedicated backends)
- Sampling strategies and their impact on observability versus cost

## Code Example
```yaml
# OpenTelemetry Collector config (minimal)
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
exporters:
  otlp/tempo:
    endpoint: tempo:4317
    headers:
      x-tenant-id: "${TENANT_ID}"
processors:
  resource:
    attributes:
      - key: tenant_id
        value: "${TENANT_ID}"
        action: upsert
  batch: {}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [resource, batch]
      exporters: [otlp/tempo]
```

Why This Is Asked
- Tests cross-cluster policy propagation, conflict handling, and secure identity management
- Validates runtime enforcement by per-tenant sidecars in a multi-cluster CNF gateway mesh
- Probes reconciliation loops and secure communication patterns

Key Concepts
- CustomResourceDefinition for TenantPolicy
- Cross-cluster replication with mTLS and SPIFFE IDs
- Dynamic gateway policy loading in sidecars
- Conflict resolution and eventual consistency

Code Example
```yaml
# CRD: TenantPolicy
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: tenantpolicies.example.com
spec:
  group: example.com
  versions:
  - name: v1
    served: true
    storage: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              tenantID:
                type: string
              namespaces:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: string
              rules:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    action:
                      type: string
                      enum: [allow, deny]
                    resources:
                      type: array
                      items:
                        type: string
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: tenantpolicies
    singular: tenantpolicy
    kind: TenantPolicy
```

```yaml
# Policy Agent Deployment
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: policy-agent
  namespace: cnf-system
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: policy-agent
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: policy-agent
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: agent
        image: policy-agent:latest
        env:
        - name: REMOTE_CLUSTER
          value: "peer-cluster.example.com"
        - name: SPIFFE_TRUST_DOMAIN
          value: "example.com"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: spiffe-bundle
          mountPath: /run/spiffe
      volumes:
      - name: spiffe-bundle
        configMap:
          name: spiffe-bundle
```

- HTTP 406 Not Acceptable response when no compatible version exists; graceful default fallback
- Observability: Prometheus metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing

## Code Example

```go
// Pseudocode for version negotiation
func negotiate(upstreamVersions []string, tenantID string) string {
    tenantVersions := registry.GetVersions(tenantID)
    allowed := intersect(upstreamVersions, tenantVersions)
    if len(allowed) == 0 {
        return DEFAULT_VERSION
    }
    return highestVersion(allowed)
}
```

## Implementation Highlights

- Extract X-TENANT-ID header in sidecar middleware
- Query central registry for tenant capabilities
- Compute intersection with upstream supported versions
- Select highest compatible version using semver comparison
- Store result in tenant-scoped cache with configurable TTL
- Return 406 if negotiation fails and no default is configured
- Emit histogram metrics for negotiation latency and cache hit rates

apiVersion: v1
